QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_5

question.text: Which professional body has been notified as the Self-Regulatory Organisation (SRO) for Social Impact Assessors under SEBI's SSE framework?

answer.text: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)
Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) — via its Section 8 subsidiary 'Institute of Social Auditors of India'
Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 2.2.6 and the SEBI circular of May 2024, the SRO is 'Institute of Social Auditors of India' — a not-for-profit Section 8 company formed under the aegis of ICAI. ICAI is the notified SRO parent. ICMAI and ICSI members can become SIAs but must register through the ICAI-promoted SRO; they are not themselves SRO bodies. **The Trap:** ICMAI (option A) is a common trap because cost accountants also sign social audits for Panchayati Raj government schemes — this is a different regime. NISM (option D) is the certifying body (runs the XXIII exam) but not the SRO. ICSI (option C) is unrelated. **Cross-Exam Context:** V-A (MF Distributor) discusses AMFI as SRO for distributors — same architecture, different profession. XIX-A (AIF Ch 1) covers the broader SRO concept. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** On empanelment, confirm your SRO membership number and NISM-XXIII certificate number match the depository-registered SIA registry — mismatches at sign-off stage delay issuance of the Annual Impact Report assurance.
